name: Tokitou Chikayuki
source:
2nd year student. Star Sign: Taurus.
Member of the Track & Field club.
No matter if they're younger or older he always talks to anyone with a friendly smile.
Even though he's considered a track prodigy he hates getting tired and often quits practicing half-way through.
